newsitem.title: USA: BE Aerospace files for four mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: BE Aerospace files for four mln shr offer.

text.p: BE Aerospace Inc said on Friday that it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for four million common share public offering.

All shares would be sold by the company, BE Aerospace said. About $5 million of the net proceeds would be used to reduce long-term debt and the balance would be used for other general corporate purposes, including working capital requirements, the company said. Morgan Stanley & Co Inc would act as the lead underwriter and CS First Boston Corp and PaineWebber Inc would be co-managers, the company said.
